name: pcb-compressing-symlink-zipslip
description: Real-library-wrap for the `compressing` npm tar-extraction path-traversal / symlink zip-slip incomplete-fix (CVE-2026-24884 -> CVE-2026-40931). Three published npm versions of `compressing` installed side-by-side via npm aliases; the service runs the REAL compressing.tar.uncompress() into a fresh temp destDir per probe and observes whether a marker file escapes to a sibling witness dir OUTSIDE destDir.
